purpose: Re-audit four nonterminal Tier-1 families against recent source authority specifically for the missing D2/D4 objects, without converting absence into scientific failure.

sources.title: Renormalization group flow of projectable Horava gravity in (3+1) dimensions
Quantizing non-projectable Horava gravity with Lagrangian path integral

HORAVA_LIFSHITZ.source_update: Projectable 3+1 marginal RG flow has asymptotically free trajectories spanning the unitary lambda range and reaching lambda near 1; non-projectable quantization made progress, but the 2025 source performs an explicit one-loop case study in 2+1 dimensions and states questions still required for a perturbative-renormalizability proof.
HORAVA_LIFSHITZ.required_gate: 3+1 same-realization UV-to-IR trajectory including relevant lower-derivative couplings, normalized extra-scalar/tensor observable and GR comparator, plus independent non-projectable/BPS disposition.

sources.title: Is lattice quantum gravity asymptotically safe? Making contact between causal dynamical triangulations and the functional renormalization group
Causal Dynamical Triangulations: New Lattice Theory of Quantum Gravity

CDT_EDT.source_update: CDT simulations permit a putative UV fixed point and provide a lattice/FRG matching program, but the 2024 source explicitly says current data precision does not prove the UV fixed point; the 2026 review states the continuum-observable program remains under development.
CDT_EDT.required_gate: same-realization multi-coupling continuum trajectory with lattice-spacing/scale setting, normalized invariant observable, identical-domain GR/EFT comparator and propagated finite-size/discretization/systematic errors.

sources.title: Foundational Issues in Group Field Theory
sources.author: Alvaro Mozota Frauca

GFT_TENSOR_MODELS.source_update: Recent review authority confirms that selected covariant GFT perturbative Feynman diagrams generate spin-foam amplitudes, supporting the already-frozen scoped EPRL/FK reduction, but does not supply a universal equivalence theorem for non-EPRL TGFT/canonical/Barrett-Crane remainders.
GFT_TENSOR_MODELS.required_gate: universality/reduction theorem for the independent TGFT remainder or a comparator-ready independent gravity observable with error transport.

sources.title: Matching the Vilkovisky-DeWitt Effective Action of Quantum Gravity to String Theory

STRING_MTHEORY_HOLOGRAPHY.source_update: Low-energy quantum-gravity EFT can be matched to explicit string constructions, but local Wilson coefficients depend on compactification details; this strengthens the requirement for a material subfamily/compactification map rather than allowing one string realization to represent the family.
STRING_MTHEORY_HOLOGRAPHY.required_gate: material subfamily and compactification census plus explicit reduction/equivalence or exhaustive family-scope certificate with comparator-ready normalized observables.
